Package model.vehicles

Klasse VehicleClass

java.lang.Object
model.vehicles.VehicleClass
Bekannte direkte Unterklassen:
BikeClass, BusClass, CarClass, MotorbikeClass
public class VehicleClass extends Object
Represents the state of a single vehicle within the SUMO simulation at a specific step

This class stores a snapshot of a vehicle's attributes (such as position, speed, and color) retrieved from the simulation via TraCI

Autor:
Minh Khoi

  • Konstruktordetails

    • VehicleClass

      public VehicleClass(String id, de.tudresden.sumo.objects.SumoColor color, de.tudresden.sumo.objects.SumoPosition2D position, double speed, String edgeId, double angle, double departure)
      Constructs a new VehicleClass instance with the specified attributes.
      Parameter:
      id - The unique identifier of the vehicle (e.g., "veh_0").
      color - The visual color of the vehicle in the simulation.
      position - The current 2D coordinates (x, y) of the vehicle.
      speed - The current velocity of the vehicle in m/s.
      edgeId - The ID of the road segment (edge) the vehicle is currently traveling on.
      angle - The navigation angle of the vehicle in degrees.
      departure - The simulation time (in seconds) when the vehicle entered the network.
